errors.ACCENT_IN_NAME: Names can't have accents, ç or other special letters («{char}»). Write it without them: for example «puntuacio» instead of «puntuació».
errors.UNTERMINATED_STRING: You opened a quote " but didn't close it on the same line.
errors.UNTERMINATED_COMMENT: You opened a comment with /* but didn't close it with */.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_INCLUDE: Here you can only write #include "raylib.h" (you wrote «{file}»).
errors.UNSUPPORTED_DIRECTIVE: We don't use instructions that start with # (like «{directive}») yet.
errors.LEADING_ZERO: Whole numbers can't start with 0: in C, a 0 in front changes the number (010 is 8!). Write «{fixed}».
errors.MISSING_SEMICOLON: There's a ; missing at the end of line {line}.
errors.EXPECTED_NAME: I expected a variable name here, but found «{found}».
errors.UNEXPECTED_TOKEN: I didn't expect to find «{found}» here.
errors.UNEXPECTED_EOF: The code ends too early. Maybe a } or a ) is missing?
errors.MISSING_BRACES: After «{keyword}», put the instructions inside braces { }.
errors.ASSIGN_IN_CONDITION: You wrote = (store a value) where you needed == (compare).
errors.VALUE_NOT_STORED: You worked out «{expr}», but didn't store it in any box. To store it, write: «{name} = {expr};»
errors.EXPECTED_ASSIGNMENT: I expected an assignment here (for example «{name} = 5;») or a function call.
errors.EXPECTED_EXPRESSION: I expected a value here (a number, a variable...) but found «{found}».
errors.INCDEC_IN_EXPRESSION: Use ++ and -- on a line of their own, for example «x++;».
errors.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: We don't use the type «{type}». Use «{use}».
errors.DECL_NEEDS_INIT: Give «{name}» a starting value. For example: {decl} {name} = 0;
errors.NO_MAIN: The main function is missing: int main(void) { ... }
errors.UNSUPPORTED_GLOBAL: Declare variables inside main, not outside it.
errors.ALREADY_DECLARED: There's already a variable called «{name}» (line {prevLine}). To change its value, don't write the type again.
errors.RESERVED_NAME: «{name}» is already a raylib name. Pick another name for your variable.
errors.NOT_A_VARIABLE: «{name}» is a function, not a variable. To call it, add parentheses: {name}(...)
errors.WRONG_ARG_COUNT: «{name}» needs {expected} values and you gave it {found}.
errors.ARG_TYPE: Value number {index} of «{name}» should be {expectedType}, but it's {foundType}.
errors.ASSIGN_TYPE: You can't store {foundType} in «{name}», which is {expectedType}.
errors.ASSIGN_TO_CONST: «{name}» is a raylib constant and can't be changed.
errors.CONDITION_TYPE: The condition must be a number or a bool, not {foundType}.
errors.MOD_NEEDS_INT: The % operator only works with whole numbers (int).
errors.VOID_VALUE: «{name}» doesn't give back a value, so you can't use it inside a calculation.
errors.STRING_NOT_ALLOWED: Text in quotes can only go inside functions like DrawText.
errors.TEXTFORMAT_ONLY_IN_DRAWTEXT: TextFormat can only be used inside DrawText.
errors.TEXTFORMAT_NEEDS_LITERAL: The first value of TextFormat must be text in quotes, for example "%d".
errors.TEXTFORMAT_FORMAT: TextFormat only understands %d (whole numbers) and %.1f, %.2f... (decimals). It doesn't know «{spec}».
errors.TEXTFORMAT_ARG_COUNT: The TextFormat text has {expected} gaps (%) but you gave it {found} values.
errors.TEXTFORMAT_ARG_TYPE: Gap {index} («{spec}») needs {expectedType}, but you gave it {foundType}.
errors.DIVISION_BY_ZERO: Division by zero! A whole number can't be divided by 0.
errors.LOOP_TOO_LONG: The loop on line {line} went round too many times without finishing the frame. Maybe it never ends, or EndDrawing() is missing?
errors.NO_WINDOW: Before {name} you need to call InitWindow to create the window.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong inside Bit Arcade while running this line. It's not your fault: try again.
errors.INT_DIVISION_TRUNCATES: Careful: {a} / {b} gives {result}, not {exact}, because whole numbers (int) lose their decimals.

features.char_literal: We don't use characters in single quotes ('a') yet. For text, use double quotes "...".
features.pointer: We haven't learned pointers (* and &) yet.
features.array: We haven't learned lists (arrays, with [ ]) yet.
features.struct: We haven't learned structures (struct and the dot .) yet.
features.function_def: We haven't learned to make our own functions yet. Put all the code inside main.
features.switch: We haven't learned switch yet. Use if / else if.
features.do: We haven't learned do-while yet. Use while.
features.break: We haven't learned break yet. Use the loop condition.
features.const: We haven't learned const yet. Use a normal variable.
features.ternary: We haven't learned the ? : operator yet. Use if / else.
features.bitwise: We don't use the &, |, ^, ~, << and >> operators. Did you mean && (and) or || (or)?
features.cast: We haven't learned type conversions with parentheses, like (int), yet.
features.multi_decl: Declare each variable on its own line.
